cards.ex: My grandpa is surprisingly tech-savvy; he even uses TikTok!
cards.exUz: Mening bobom juda texnik xabardor; u hatto TikTokdan ham foydalanadi!
cards.uzDef: Texnologiyalar va qurilmalarni yaxshi biladigan, ulardan foydalanishni uddalaydigan odam.

cards.ex: This new printer is plug and play; no complicated setup required.
cards.exUz: Bu yangi printer o'rnat va ishlat; murakkab sozlash talab etilmaydi.
cards.uzDef: O'rnatish oson va darhol ishlaydigan qurilma yoki dasturiy ta'minot.

cards.ex: That funny cat video went viral overnight.
cards.exUz: O'sha kulgili mushuk videosi bir kechada viral bo'lib ketdi.
cards.uzDef: Internetda tez va keng tarqalib ketmoq, ko'p odamlar ko'rmoq.

cards.ex: I need to power up my laptop before the meeting.
cards.exUz: Uchrashuvdan oldin noutbukimni yoqishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Qurilmani yoqish, elektr ta'minotini ulash.

cards.ex: Try to reboot your computer if it's running slowly.
cards.exUz: Agar kompyuteringiz sekin ishlayotgan bo'lsa, uni qayta yuklab ko'ring.
cards.uzDef: Qurilmani o'chirib yoqish, qayta ishga tushirish.

cards.ex: My internet connection is lagging; I can't stream the movie.
cards.exUz: Internet aloqam qotyapti; men filmni ko'ra olmayapman.
cards.uzDef: Qurilma yoki internet sekin ishlashi, kechikish.

cards.ex: Be careful what you post online; it's part of your digital footprint.
cards.exUz: Onlaynda nima joylashtirayotganingizga e'tibor bering; bu sizning raqamli izingizning bir qismidir.
cards.uzDef: Internetda qoldirilgan ma'lumotlar, harakatlar va izlar.

cards.ex: I was scrolling through Instagram when I saw your post.
cards.exUz: Men Instagramni aylanib ko'rayotgan edim, sizning postingizni ko'rib qoldim.
cards.uzDef: Ekranda ro'yxatni yoki sahifalarni pastga surib ko'rish.

cards.ex: Remember to back up your files regularly to avoid data loss.
cards.exUz: Ma'lumotlar yo'qolishining oldini olish uchun fayllaringizni muntazam ravishda zaxira nusxasini oling.
cards.uzDef: Ma'lumotlarni saqlash uchun nusxa ko'chirmoq.

cards.ex: There was a glitch in the system, and we lost some data.
cards.exUz: Tizimda nosozlik yuz berdi va biz bir qancha ma'lumotlarni yo'qotdik.
cards.uzDef: Kichik texnik muammo, xato.

cards.ex: You can cut and paste the text into the document.
cards.exUz: Matnni hujjatga nusxa olishingiz mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Matnni yoki rasmni bir joydan boshqa joyga ko'chirib o'tkazmoq.

cards.ex: My hard drive is almost full; I need to delete some files.
cards.exUz: Mening qattiq diskim deyarli to'lgan; ba'zi fayllarni o'chirishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Kompyuterda ma'lumotlarni saqlash uchun ishlatiladigan qurilma.

cards.ex: Which operating system do you prefer: Windows or macOS?
cards.exUz: Qaysi operatsion tizimni afzal ko'rasiz: Windows yoki macOS?
cards.uzDef: Kompyuterning ishlashini boshqaradigan dasturiy ta'minot.

cards.ex: I found a Wi-Fi hotspot at the coffee shop.
cards.exUz: Men qahvaxonada Wi-Fi nuqtasini topdim.
cards.uzDef: Simsiz internetga ulanish imkonini beradigan joy.

cards.ex: I'm downloading the latest version of the software.
cards.exUz: Men dasturiy ta'minotning eng so'nggi versiyasini yuklab olyapman.
cards.uzDef: Internetdan kompyuterga fayl ko'chirib olmoq.

cards.ex: I need to upload the presentation to the server.
cards.exUz: Men taqdimotni serverga yuklashim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Kompyuterdan internetga fayl joylamoq.

cards.ex: I like to stream movies on Netflix.
cards.exUz: Men Netflixda filmlarni oqimda ko'rishni yaxshi ko'raman.
cards.uzDef: Internet orqali real vaqtda video yoki audio ko'rmoq.

cards.ex: Connect your headphones using Bluetooth.
cards.exUz: Quloqchinlaringizni Bluetooth orqali ulang.
cards.uzDef: Simsiz ma'lumot uzatish texnologiyasi.

cards.ex: I use cloud storage to back up all my important documents.
cards.exUz: Men barcha muhim hujjatlarimni zaxiralash uchun bulutli saqlashdan foydalanaman.
cards.uzDef: Ma'lumotlarni internetda saqlash xizmati.

cards.ex: Be aware of phishing scams that try to steal your passwords.
cards.exUz: Parollaringizni o'g'irlashga urinayotgan firibgarliklardan ehtiyot bo'ling.
cards.uzDef: Shaxsiy ma'lumotlarni o'g'irlashga qaratilgan internet firibgarligi.

cards.ex: I'm trying to reduce my screen time to improve my sleep.
cards.exUz: Uyquimni yaxshilash uchun ekran vaqtimni qisqartirishga harakat qilyapman.
cards.uzDef: Qurilma ekraniga sarflangan vaqt.

cards.ex: Digital literacy is essential in today's world.
cards.exUz: Raqamli savodxonlik bugungi kunda muhimdir.
cards.uzDef: Raqamli texnologiyalardan to'g'ri va samarali foydalanish qobiliyati.

cards.ex: That computer is using outdated technology; it needs to be replaced.
cards.exUz: Bu kompyuter eskirgan texnologiyadan foydalanmoqda; uni almashtirish kerak.
cards.uzDef: Hozirgi kunda dolzarb bo'lmagan, eski texnologiya.

cards.ex: This software is very user-friendly; even beginners can use it.
cards.exUz: Bu dasturiy ta'minot juda qulay; hatto yangi boshlovchilar ham undan foydalanishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Foydalanish oson, tushunarli interfeysga ega.

cards.ex: I called tech support to help me fix my computer.
cards.exUz: Kompyuterimni tuzatishga yordam berish uchun texnik yordamga qo'ng'iroq qildim.
cards.uzDef: Texnik muammolarni hal qilishda yordam beradigan xizmat.

cards.ex: Our company is trying to go paperless to be more environmentally friendly.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyamiz atrof-muhitga do'stona bo'lish uchun qog'ozdan foydalanishni kamaytirishga harakat qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Qog'ozdan foydalanishni kamaytirish yoki to'xtatish.

cards.ex: I don't have a signal here; I can't make a call.
cards.exUz: Bu yerda aloqa yo'q; men qo'ng'iroq qila olmayman.
cards.uzDef: Mobil telefon aloqasi mavjud bo'lish.

cards.ex: My phone ran out of battery, so I couldn't call you.
cards.exUz: Telefonimning batareyasi tugadi, shuning uchun sizga qo'ng'iroq qila olmadim.
cards.uzDef: Qurilma batareyasi to'liq tugab qolmoq.

cards.ex: Please turn off your phone during the movie.
cards.exUz: Iltimos, kino paytida telefoningizni o'chiring.
cards.uzDef: Qurilmani o'chirish.

cards.ex: You should update your software to get the latest features.
cards.exUz: So'nggi funksiyalarga ega bo'lish uchun dasturingizni yangilashingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Dasturiy ta'minotning so'nggi versiyasini o'rnatish.
